text:
mira: quick sync: i prototyped a \"coexistence operator\" to route tenants between envelope-shim, frame-shim, or passthrough for the v2->v3 streaming cutover. question: operator-first or per-node sidecars? cc @jason @kate
jason: operator-first. sidecars are simple but multiply ops cost. operator centralizes routing & makes tenant-level rollouts easy.
kate: operator ok if latency is tiny and we have solid diagnostics + rollback gates. watch prefix-cache interactions.
samir: tl;dr: operator = infra effort (CRD/controller) but lower recurring cost; sidecar = less infra dev but higher mem/cpu and harder fine-grained canaries.
mira: prototype uses a ShimPolicy CRD (reuses existing routing CRD) that matches header, tenantLabel, then payload-sniff. it patches tenant annotations our ingress respects. example snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: infra.redwood/v1
kind: ShimPolicy
spec:
  match:
    headerContains: "x-redwood-client: v3"
    tenantLabels: ["migrating"]
  route:
    primary: frame_shim_v3
    fallback: envelope_legacy
  tuning:
    max_in_flight: 64
    enable_batching: true
  safety:
    max_error_pct: 4
    window_seconds: 300
  auditTag: "shim:frame_v3"
```
jason: add `detectionOrder` and `priority` to avoid ambiguous rules. operator should support shadowing (mirror traffic) before switching live.
kate: detection must handle clients w/o headers. sniff first frame for a `v3-init` token and route accordingly. debug endpoint for support is a must.
ops-ux: ops needs a per-tenant console toggle + API with audit log. quick flips for emergency opt-out.
samir: telemetry MUST include shim_id, shim_latency_p50/p95, shim_errors_total and a baggage tag `shim_route` on spans. correlate request_id->shim.
mira: operator will annotate billing logs with `auditTag` so finance can reconcile. also plan `/debug/routing?tenant=...` to show why a tenant is on legacy.
jason: rollout plan: shadow 0.5% -> live 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. gates: p95 up >10% or error_rate >2% -> auto rollback + page. include manual approval at 10% and 50%.
kate: add prefix-cache integrity smoke test; last migration caused cache thrash and p95 spike.
samir: operator must expose global kill-switch + per-tenant opt-out. also need infra-security review and a runbook for controller failures.
infra-bot: infra-bot: security review required for controllers that mutate ingress routing. please open ticket in #eng-security with design doc and runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: branch `arch/coexist-operator-v1` created; CI started. unit tests running.
mira: i'll open RFC follow-up PR with ShimPolicy schema, runbook, metrics dashboards, and rollback playbook. aiming to canary next week.
jason: include cost estimates (operator infra vs sidecar costs) for finance sign-off.
kate: +1 if latency validated and diagnostics are good.
ops-ux: i'll prototype console toggle & audit UI and share tomorrow.
mira: thanks all — ping me if you want to pair on smoke tests. :thumbsup:
